title: Conversation Correction Handling
claimTested: Spoon can use a later correction for current belief while preserving the earlier statement as history.

phases.purpose: Apply a later correction with Teacher removed.

input.prompt: Wait, no, Dash is five. Don't forget the correction.

criteria: preserves the earlier statement as history

phases.purpose: Ask for the current corrected fact after the correction.

criteria: answers five using the corrected current belief
